# Upstream build inputs

These four files are unmodified copies of `data/extensions/aseprite-theme/`
from [aseprite/aseprite](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/tree/14fe117e853bd642672e72018166239506060cd4/data/extensions/aseprite-theme):

- `theme.xml`: theme roles, styles, and atlas coordinates
- `sheet.png`: default-theme artwork and specialized tool/cursor glyphs
- `package.json`: upstream authors and metadata
- `LICENSE.txt`: upstream CC BY 4.0 notice

Source commit: `14fe117e853bd642672e72018166239506060cd4`.
Copied 14 October 2026. Keep these inputs unchanged when editing the adaptation;
make changes in `scripts/build.ps1` instead.

No Aseprite application source, executable, or font files are included.
